title: adaption (@adaption_ai)
summary:
Adaption Labs CEO @sarahookr says data centers in space are "pretty bonkers", and explains what the current consensus gets wrong:
"Most co-located hardware is pretty much for training. I think that's why you care [about Space], otherwise you can distribute. Inference compute, which is where everything's moving towards, you can spread that compute more easily. You can have multiple data centers [on Earth]."
"So if you care about space, you probably only care about training compute. I think people underestimate the amount of failures that happen, and you don't want to get your training job interrupted."
"The real issue is that GPUs still have failure rates. The 2% of GPUs that are just considered done every year, that's really your cost. It's how quickly you can replace those [in space] and what that looks like."
🎬 https://pbs.twimg.com/amplify_video_thumb/2021274974674460672/img/q71urvsxACb7Ts2M.jpg | https://video.twimg.com/amplify_video/2021274974674460672/vid/avc1/480x270/bNZqNwtqJ9B6LvMI.mp4?tag=14

i just adapted my first dataset on @adaption_ai and it was definitely a learning process for me.
built a dataset called “socials sentiment” which captures real social media conversations labeled for negative (0), neutral (1) and positive (2) sentiments.
i designed this to help ai understand how people express opinions online.
with the help of @huggingface i was able to tokenize, organize and prepare my dataset for ai analysis.
spent 3 out of my allocated 50 credits to launch this.
adaption result:
> 330% improvement
> 8.6/10 adaptive text score
> B grade (hopefully i get A on my next)
> 31.5% adaption
